audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phases[N].side read 'Skill' while content win[N] and packet.levelChart read 'Lulu' on every row — the page argues with itself across the whole chart.
audit.why: Lulu's Glitterlance slow, Whimsy polymorph/peel, Help Pix! shield and Wild Growth all directly answer Blitzcrank's single-target engage at every stage; the content layer's whys[] already document a Lulu-favored lane throughout.
audit.corrected: Moved all seven phases[N].side to 'Lulu' and rewrote each .why to match; win[N] already read Lulu on every row so no content edit was needed.

audit.why: Wild Growth (R, 120/100/80s) correctly identified as the level-6 hard counter that saves whoever gets hooked.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit; report[8].t and report[9].t misgender Lulu as 'his'; two Do's/Don'ts bullets paste tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles (lintFindings).
audit.why: Whimsy (W) is a flat 18s cooldown; Glitterlance (Q) is a flat 7s; Wild Growth (R) is 120/100/80s. Lulu is she/her per champ-gender data.
audit.corrected: Added real cooldowns, fixed both misgendered pronouns, rewrote the two bled bullets to match their own titles.

edits.before: The hook threat IS level 1 — their duo plays behind minions or pays immediately.
edits.after: Glitterlance slow and Whimsy peel beat your level-1 hook approach before it lands.

edits.before: E joins: hook-fist is live and the lane's geometry answers to your arm.
edits.after: She polymorphs or speeds away from every all-in you start at level 2.

edits.before: Full kit: W the flank angles — the hook from fog is the lane's scariest sentence.
edits.after: Her Help, Pix! shield blunts your engage damage before Power Fist ever lands.

edits.before: Zone with the arm — every minion they hide behind is tempo you taxed for free.
edits.after: Through 4-5 her poke and peel keep you out of reliable hook range entirely.

edits.before: Static Field online — the silence finishes what the fist started.
edits.after: Wild Growth hard-counters the single-target pick your kit depends on.

edits.before: First item: the grab chains delete and the overdrive flanks multiply.
edits.after: First item, she still shields and speeds your hooked target to safety.

edits.before: Late Blitz is one hook from winning: fish the chokes, fist the catch, and silence the channel.
edits.after: Late, Whimsy plus Wild Growth negate the isolated pick your whole kit depends on entirely.

edits.before: - Lulu Whimsy (Polymorph): matchup-defining — The polymorph deletes a carry’s kit mid-fight — bait it before the real engage. It writes your spacing rules. - W Overdrive is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Whimsy (Polymorph) is a flat 18s cooldown that deletes a carry's kit mid-fight — bait it before the real engage. - Glitterlance (Q) repokes every 7s regardless of rank. - Wild Growth (R) resets at 120/100/80s and saves whoever you just hooked.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Watch for Lulu drifting away from her carry with Whimsy already spent, then commit the grab immediately.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Standing in Glitterlance range between hooks just banks free poke and slow damage onto you for nothing.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mercs-Steelcaps by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mercs-Steelcaps by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into her duo’s sustain.

edits.after: Commit on Whimsy (Polymorph)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Her answer goes first; yours goes last.

notes: Level chart was fully contradictory: all seven phases[N].side said 'Skill' while win[N]/packet both said 'Lulu' on every row — corrected side+why together, win[N] untouched since it already matched. packet.defects also flags that the 7/7 Lulu chart conflicts with Blitzcrank's 53.39% aggregate win rate; that is a data-layer question (win rate vs per-stage chart, not something this proposal's writable paths control) and is left for the tooling to reconcile — recorded here for visibility. breakdown.wave, breakdown.carry, breakdown.difficulty, tradeGood/tradeBad remain templated but not factually wrong; left for time budget.
